# RingWorld 1.1 — Minecraft 26.2

Separate Fabric and NeoForge builds for **Minecraft 26.2**. Use one jar matching
your loader. Java 25 is required; Fabric also requires Fabric API 0.158.0+26.2.
Qualified loader pins: Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or NeoForge 26.2.0.69.

Includes 26.2-specific rendering, menu and world-generation adapters while
preserving the shared RingWorld gameplay and save contracts. Reversed-depth
rendering uses the 26.2 GPU convention. The older 26.1.x line remains separate.

Back up saves before upgrading and never downgrade a save opened in 26.2.
The Atlas fills in progressively and resumes saved generation progress.
The live demo server has not been upgraded. Experimental Vulkan and
third-party renderer compatibility are not covered by OpenGL qualification.

[Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/ringworld/versions) ·
[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ringworld/files)

Files were submitted as Release. Host/project moderation may still delay
discovery. Both hosts' downloaded jars match the attached SHA256SUMS.txt.

Corresponding MPL-2.0 source:
[1cfac9b10648054e46f4303f6e8b87df9b9bcdba](https://github.com/Delaser/RingWorld/commit/1cfac9b10648054e46f4303f6e8b87df9b9bcdba).
Staged metadata-only release changes passed the runtime equivalence guard;
later fixture/documentation fixes do not change these jars.
Full evidence: `docs/RELEASE_1_1_PUBLICATION_2026-08-27.md` on main.

# RingWorld 1.1 — Minecraft 26.1.x

Fabric and NeoForge builds for Minecraft **26.1, 26.1.1 and 26.1.2**.
Use one jar matching your loader. Java 25 is required; Fabric also needs
Fabric API for your exact Minecraft patch.

This release extends 1.0 beyond its original 26.1.2-only support with reviewed
cross-patch qualification, world-upgrade checks and version-aware packaging.
Minecraft 26.2 uses a separate release, not these jars.

Back up saves before upgrading. The Atlas generates progressively: real
chunks first, a fogged colour surface next, then full height geometry. Saved
progress resumes after restarting. The live demo server is not upgraded by
this release. Third-party renderer compatibility is not claimed.

[Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/ringworld/versions) ·
[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ringworld/files)

releases.notes:
## RingWorld 1.0 — Minecraft 26.1.2 Fabric

- A finite, configurable Overworld that truly wraps around one canonical X
  plane with continuous entities, interactions, vehicles, combat and terrain.
- Curved terrain, clouds, sky lighting, finite textured rims, and a complete-
  ring Atlas beyond ordinary chunk render distance.
- Three world-size presets plus custom immutable dimensions and live geometry,
  walking-time, Atlas and generation estimates.
- Resumable whole-ring Atlas generation with progressive terrain colouring,
  generation haze, a visible progress indicator and durable cache recovery.
- Corrected annular terrain generation for new worlds while older alpha worlds
  retain their persisted historical mapping.
- Seam-safe structures, portals, beds, maps, compasses, raids, block entities,
  redstone, fluids, double chests and bidirectional block placement.
- Vanilla Nether and End, with multi-lap Nether returns normalized into the
  finite Overworld band.

## First launch and Atlas generation

The world is playable immediately. Nearby terrain is made from normal,
authoritative Minecraft chunks. The distant ring appears in layers: first a
fogged biome-coloured stand-in, then progressively streamed surface detail,
then the complete curved texture and height mesh at 100%.

`Ring Atlas Generating: X%` remains at the top left while the distant Atlas is
incomplete. Open **RingWorld Map** from the pause menu for its live rate and
ETA, or to start, pause and resume the job when permitted. Progress is saved;
you do not need to walk a lap. Medium and Large rings can take tens of minutes
or longer depending on CPU, storage, seed, active players and other mods.

Install RingWorld on the server and every client. Fabric requires Fabric API.
See the project page for known compatibility limits.

Corresponding source: [exact immutable commit](https://github.com/Delaser/RingWorld/commit/f3a5ce12a3d72a7e2253e893ca385e27f3fe7448).
